text:
Which statement about magnesium chloride, MgCl 2, is correct?
5
A
Molten magnesium chloride conducts electricity because its electrons are free to move.
B
It consists of anions and cations which have completely filled outer electron shells.
C
It has a high melting point because its covalent bonds are very strong.
D
The magnesium ions and chloride ions are bonded together by delocalised electrons.

options.label: A
options.text: Molten magnesium chloride conducts electricity because its electrons are free to move.

options.label: B
options.text: It consists of anions and cations which have completely filled outer electron shells.

options.label: C
options.text: It has a high melting point because its covalent bonds are very strong.

options.label: D
options.text: The magnesium ions and chloride ions are bonded together by delocalised electrons.
